news.analysis: Irving has been impactful out of the Tampa Bay backfield of late, rushing for at least one touchdown and over 60 yards in five of his last six games. The running back remains the lone trustworthy option in an underperforming Buccaneers offense for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.

news.title: Bucky Irving reaches end zone in Week 11 loss to Lions

In his first game back from a hamstring injury that landed him on Injured Reserve, Etienne played a season-low 33% of the offensive snaps in the Week 10 loss to the division-rival Carolina Panthers, being outsnapped by Estime. news.contents: Los Angeles Rams running back Blake Corum continues to solidify himself as a solid RB2 option in fantasy football heading into Wednesday's Week 12 contest against the Green Bay Packers. news.analysis: Nabers led the Giants in targets, receptions, and yards by a wide margin; no other receiver had more than three catches or 35 yards. Of course, we'd want more on 12 targets, but it's hard to complain too much. He gets a decent matchup against the Colts next week.
news.contents: Malik Nabers caught 7 of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.title: Malik Nabers snags touchdown in win over Jags

news.analysis: Egbuka has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Tampa Bay passing attack, finishing under 50 receiving yards in each of his last five games. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options for head coach Todd Bowles ahead of a Week 12 matchup against the Carolina Panthers.
news.contents: Emeka Egbuka hauled in just two of his five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions in Week 11.
news.title: Emeka Egbuka disappoints in Week 11 loss

news.contents: Tampa Bay Buccaneers wide receiver Emeka Egbuka finished with 3.8 PPR points in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Detroit Lions, catching two of five targets for 18 yards. Rookie Ted Hurst III led Tampa Bay with seven targets and caught both of Baker Mayfield's touchdown passes. Hurst had drawn one target in each of the previous three games. Egbuka had one catch for six yards through three quarters. Three of his five targets came in the fourth, including a 12-yard catch with Tampa Bay down 10 and ...
news.title: Emeka Egbuka Is Harder to Trust as a Flex

news.analysis: Stevens was busy on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium, hitting field goals from 36, 40, 25, 41, and 26 yards out. His final field goal was the game-winner as time expired. Stevens has now made 22 of his 25 field-goal attempts and added 16 extra points this year. He will take on the Cardinals in Week 12.
news.contents: Drew Stevens made all five of his field-goal attempts and added an extra point in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11.
